title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Service Fee Schedule
content:
Apart from annual rent and late fees, a Safe Deposit Boxes rental can carry a handful of service charges. Their amounts depend on the box size and are listed here in US dollars.

## What each charge is

- **Drilling fee**: charged for forcing a box open.
- **Lock-change fee**: charged for changing the lock after a key has been lost or has not been returned.
- **Key deposit**: charged when the keys are issued, and refundable.
- **Co-lessee add fee**: charged for adding a co-lessee to a rental.
- **Size-change fee**: charged for moving a rental to a box of another size.
- **After-hours access fee**: charged for each appointment to visit the vault outside lobby hours; where a size has no such access, the fee is marked not applicable.

## Amounts by box size (USD)

| Box size | Drilling | Lock change | Key deposit | Co-lessee add | Size change | After-hours visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 175.00 | 125.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 175.00 | 125.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 175.00 | 125.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 225.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 225.00 | 150.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 250.00 | 175.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 per appointment |

## Quick answers

- *Does adding a co-lessee cost anything?* The add fee is 0.00 for every size.
- *Does switching sizes carry a fee?* The size-change fee is 0.00 for every size.
- *Is the key deposit the same everywhere?* Yes, 25.00 for each of the six sizes.
- *Which size has a priced after-hours visit?* Only the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box, at 50.00 per appointment.
